item_description:
Script: dpe tshugs.
Double numbering of the folios in the left margin on the recto:
- Volume letter Da (follows volume Tha, see (ID:5410) and precedes volume Na, see (ID:5414)), from 1 to 44.
- From 363 to 404, with two folios numbered 382 (gya gnyis gong ma, 3-gya gnyis) and two folios numbered 387 (3-gya bdun, 3-gya bdun 'og ma).
Lines per folio: 7, 6 on fol. 1b, 2a, 2b.
Abbreviations.
No annotations (only a few corrections).
Proofread once (cig zhus || dag go |).
Miniatures left (rje ye shes dpal) and right (rje sangs rgyas grub pa) on fol. 1b, and left (rje rin po che dkon mchog rgyal mtshan pa) and right (rje sangs rgyas seng ge pa) on fol. 2a.
